provenance.procedure: GET /find/tt0700700?external_source=imdb_id with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb find-imdb.
provenance.note: Synthesised: /find resolves an external id to TMDB's own, answering with the matches split by kind. The client reads only the list for the Work's kind (movie_results for a film), so a movie's imdb id never resolves to a same-named series.
